description:
List conversations of the inbox, newest activity first.

Returns one entry per conversation with contact info, unread count, last
message, current assignee (user and/or group), and tags.

assigned_to_me.description: Only conversations assigned to the calling user.

channel_id.description: The 360dialog channel ID of the inbox to operate on.

tag_id.description: Only conversations carrying this tag (see list_tags).

unread.description: Only conversations with unread incoming messages.

name: getchat_list_conversations
title: List conversations
